title: handicap — pamphlet

sentences.sentence: Not speaking the language is a real handicap.
sentences.translation: 不会讲这种语言的确是一个障碍。

sentences.sentence: Now draw or trace ten dinosaurs in ascending order of size.
sentences.translation: 现在按大小以升序画或描出10只恐龙。

sentences.sentence: What does the word ‘curriculum’ denote that ‘course’ does not?
sentences.translation: curriculum一词的哪些含义是course没有的？

sentences.sentence: As you lower your pen whilst continuing the motion, you should notice the resulting shape is more regular than it otherwise would have been.
sentences.translation: 随着你降低你的笔，同时保持圆周运动，你应该会注意到画出的形状比起不这样做画出的形状要规范的多。

sentences.sentence: Indeed, it is important to keep fit and healthy, whilst we all aspire to improve the way we look and feel in order to make good first and lasting impressions.
sentences.translation: 事实上，为了得到一个良好的初次印象和持续印象，在保持体形和健康的同时，我们也渴望提高自己看待和感受他人的方式。

sentences.sentence: Modules participate in a dynamic life cycle which includes the ability to add, update and remove modules at runtime, whilst preserving the state in the system.
sentences.translation: 模块参与到动态的生命周期里，这个动态的生命周期能够在运行时添加、更新、删除模块，同时保留系统中的状态。

sentences.sentence: Just as different sounding words may have the same soundex, the reverse situation can also occur: words that sound identical, called homophones, may have different codes.
sentences.translation: 正如发音不同的单词有可能有相同的 soundex，反过来的情况也有可能发生：发音相同的单词，叫做 同音词（homophone），可能有不同的代码。

sentences.sentence: a convicted murderer
sentences.translation: 已定罪的谋杀犯

sentences.sentence: refugees suffering from malnutrition
sentences.translation: 营养不良的难民

sentences.sentence: the great potato famine in Ireland
sentences.translation: 爱尔兰严重的土豆荒

sentences.sentence: A million people are facing famine .
sentences.translation: 一百万人正面临饥荒。

sentences.sentence: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
sentences.translation: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

sentences.sentence: Murphy’s Tavern
sentences.translation: 墨菲酒馆

phrases.translation: 和平倡议，倡议和平；和平的开端

sentences.sentence: I wish my son would show more initiative.
sentences.translation: 我希望我的儿子能表现得再主动一些。

sentences.sentence: Don’t keep asking me for advice. Use your initiative.
sentences.translation: 别老是要我给你出主意，发挥一下你自己的决断能力吧。

sentences.sentence: Lt. Carlos was not obeying orders. He acted on his own initiative (= he was not told what to do ).
sentences.translation: 卡洛斯中尉没有服从命令，而是自作主张。

sentences.sentence: What provides anonymity for the whistleblower?
sentences.translation: 是什么为告密者提供匿名性？

sentences.sentence: old footage from the First World War
sentences.translation: 第一次世界大战时期的旧影像

sentences.sentence: You're being very scrupulous, but to what end?
sentences.translation: 你表现得很讲良心，但目的是什么呢？

sentences.sentence: I have been scrupulous about telling them the dangers.
sentences.translation: 我告诉他们这些危险是很讲良心的。

sentences.sentence: They became more vociferous, and some of them began calling out what they thought of Hanna.
sentences.translation: 他们变得更加吵闹了，一些人开始叫嚷着对汉娜的看法。

sentences.sentence: And one by one, encouraged by vociferous applause, speaking with fire and enthusiasm and excited gestures, they replied to the attack.
sentences.translation: 他们一个个受到喧闹的欢呼鼓掌的鼓励，怀着火焰和激情，打着激动的手势，回答了对他们的攻击。

sentences.sentence: Listen to all the voices -- not just here but even more stridently in Europe -- calling for a need to restore fiscal discipline.
sentences.translation: 听听这众多的声音——不但在这里，在欧洲更加刺耳——要求回归财政纪律。

sentences.sentence: a political pamphlet
sentences.translation: 政治宣传册

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 13 单元

handicap
音标：英 /'hændikæp/  美 /'hændɪ'kæp/
n. 障碍
短语：mental handicap — 心理缺陷；心智障碍
短语：physical handicap — 身体缺陷；生理缺陷
例句：Not speaking the language is a real handicap.
不会讲这种语言的确是一个障碍。

ascending
音标：英 /ə'sendiŋ/  美 /ə'sɛndɪŋ/
adj. 上升的
短语：ascending order — 升序
短语：ascending aorta — 升主动脉；上行织脉[医]
短语：ascending colon — 升结肠；上行结肠
短语：ascending motion — 上升运动
短语：ascending pipe — 直管；注入管；增压管
短语：sort ascending — n. [计]升序
例句：Now draw or trace ten dinosaurs in ascending order of size.
现在按大小以升序画或描出10只恐龙。

denote
音标：英 /dɪˈnoʊt/  美 /dɪ'not/
v. 表示，表明
例句：What does the word ‘curriculum’ denote that ‘course’ does not?
curriculum一词的哪些含义是course没有的？

whilst
音标：英 /waɪlst/  美 /hwailst/
conj. 同时
例句：As you lower your pen whilst continuing the motion, you should notice the resulting shape is more regular than it otherwise would have been.
随着你降低你的笔，同时保持圆周运动，你应该会注意到画出的形状比起不这样做画出的形状要规范的多。
例句：Indeed, it is important to keep fit and healthy, whilst we all aspire to improve the way we look and feel in order to make good first and lasting impressions.
事实上，为了得到一个良好的初次印象和持续印象，在保持体形和健康的同时，我们也渴望提高自己看待和感受他人的方式。
例句：Modules participate in a dynamic life cycle which includes the ability to add, update and remove modules at runtime, whilst preserving the state in the system.
模块参与到动态的生命周期里，这个动态的生命周期能够在运行时添加、更新、删除模块，同时保留系统中的状态。

homophones
音标：英 /'hɒməfəʊnz/
n. 同音同形异义词
例句：Just as different sounding words may have the same soundex, the reverse situation can also occur: words that sound identical, called homophones, may have different codes.
正如发音不同的单词有可能有相同的 soundex，反过来的情况也有可能发生：发音相同的单词，叫做 同音词（homophone），可能有不同的代码。

arbitrarily
音标：英 /'ɑ:bɪtrəlɪ/  美 /,ɑrbə'trɛrəli/
adv. 武断地；专横地

convict
音标：英 /kənˈvɪkt/  美 /kən'vɪkt/
v. 证明...有罪
例句：a convicted murderer
已定罪的谋杀犯

malnutrition
音标：英 /mælnjʊ'trɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /'mælnʊ'trɪʃən/
n. 营养不良
例句：refugees suffering from malnutrition
营养不良的难民

famine
音标：英 /'fæmɪn/  美 /'fæmɪn/
n. 饥荒
例句：the great potato famine in Ireland
爱尔兰严重的土豆荒
例句：A million people are facing famine .
一百万人正面临饥荒。

adolescence
音标：英 /ædə'les(ə)ns/  美 /,ædə'lɛsns/
n. 青春期
短语：late adolescence — 青春晚期
例句：Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

tavern
音标：英 /'tæv(ə)n/  美 /'tævɚn/
n. 酒馆
例句：Murphy’s Tavern
墨菲酒馆

discursive
音标：英 /dɪs'kɜːsɪv/  美 /dɪs'kɝsɪv/
adj. 不着边际的

initiative
音标：英 /ɪ'nɪʃɪətɪv/  美 /ɪ'nɪʃətɪv/
n. 行动，主动性
短语：take the initiative — 采取主动；带头
短语：on one's own initiative — 主动地
短语：subjective initiative — 主观能动性
短语：have the initiative — 掌握主动
短语：take initiative — 积极主动
短语：learning initiative — 学习积极性
短语：peace initiative — 和平倡议，倡议和平；和平的开端
短语：proliferation security initiative — 防扩散安全倡议
例句：I wish my son would show more initiative.
我希望我的儿子能表现得再主动一些。
例句：Don’t keep asking me for advice. Use your initiative.
别老是要我给你出主意，发挥一下你自己的决断能力吧。
例句：Lt. Carlos was not obeying orders. He acted on his own initiative (= he was not told what to do ).
卡洛斯中尉没有服从命令，而是自作主张。

whistleblower
音标：英 /'hwɪsəl,bloɚ/  美 /'hwɪsəl,bloɚ/
n. 告密者
例句：What provides anonymity for the whistleblower?
是什么为告密者提供匿名性？

footage
音标：英 /'fʊtɪdʒ/  美 /'fʊtɪdʒ/
n. 电影片段
短语：square footage — 建筑面积
例句：old footage from the First World War
第一次世界大战时期的旧影像

scrupulous
音标：英 /'skruːpjʊləs/  美 /'skrupjələs/
adj. 严谨的，小心的
例句：You're being very scrupulous, but to what end?
你表现得很讲良心，但目的是什么呢？
例句：I have been scrupulous about telling them the dangers.
我告诉他们这些危险是很讲良心的。

vociferous
音标：英 /və(ʊ)'sɪf(ə)rəs/  美 /vo'sɪfərəs/
adj. 喧闹的
例句：They became more vociferous, and some of them began calling out what they thought of Hanna.
他们变得更加吵闹了，一些人开始叫嚷着对汉娜的看法。
例句：And one by one, encouraged by vociferous applause, speaking with fire and enthusiasm and excited gestures, they replied to the attack.
他们一个个受到喧闹的欢呼鼓掌的鼓励，怀着火焰和激情，打着激动的手势，回答了对他们的攻击。

stridently
音标：英 /'straidentli/
adv. 刺耳地
例句：Listen to all the voices -- not just here but even more stridently in Europe -- calling for a need to restore fiscal discipline.
听听这众多的声音——不但在这里，在欧洲更加刺耳——要求回归财政纪律。

strikingly
音标：英 /'straɪkɪŋli/  美 /'straɪkɪŋli/
adv. 引人注目地

pamphlet
音标：英 /ˈpæmflɪt/  美 /ˈpæmflɪt/
n. 小册子，手册
例句：a political pamphlet
政治宣传册
